Fabric Composition: 100% undyed Gotland wool, milled in West Yorkshire

60% undyed Gotland wool, 30% reclaimed Donegal lambswool, 10% kid mohair; interlining 100% organic cotton canvas; body lining 100% cupro; sleeve lining 100% viscose twill; horn buttons; woven and fulled at a single mill in West Yorkshire, cut on the straight grain and finished by hand in Copenhagen over two fittings
